## Two steppers, the second in a fragment

A starts at 0; the wrapper appears once A is through, B only steps after that.

::: {.explain-code}
```{.py}
a = 1
b = 2
```

:::: {lines="1"}
A one.
::::

:::: {lines="2"}
A two.
::::
:::

::: {.fragment}
::: {.explain-code}
```{.py}
c = 3
d = 4
```

:::: {lines="1"}
B one.
::::

:::: {lines="2"}
B two.
::::
:::
:::

## The videos of a second stepper

`data-play-on` moves with the stepper: its sections play at steps 3 and 4 of
the slide.

::: {.explain-code}
```{.py}
a = 1
b = 2
```

:::: {lines="1"}
One.
::::

:::: {lines="2"}
Two.
::::
:::

::: {.explain-manim}
```{.python .manim}
from manim import *


class DefaultTemplate(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.next_section("one")
        self.next_section("two")
```

:::: {section="one"}
Section one.
::::

:::: {section="two"}
Section two.
::::
:::

## A single-step stepper before a fragment

Its only caption stays instead of fading out; the fragment after it takes
index 0.

::: {.explain-code}
```{.py}
rows = load(path)
```

:::: {lines="1"}
Only step.
::::
:::

::: {.fragment}
Then this.
:::
